name: Augment Undead
body:
Your created or animated undead are more powerful than normal.

Prerequisite: Spell Focus (necromancy).

Benefit: undead creature you create using lesser animate dead, animate dead, create undead, create greater undead or similar spells gains a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and +2 hit points per Hit Die.
